svg.text: IRONKIN · Confidential · All measurements in cm · TBC = to be confirmed
PATTERN PIECES · 6 pieces · schematic, not to scale
Pocket goes on the right back leg
Clean exterior, no holes or cord
Embroider the anvil on P4, then stitch the pocket to the right back
Join front and back legs at the outer side seams with exposed cream
Join the two legs along the front and back rise.
Make up the waistband P3 with elastic P5 and drawcord P6, eyelets on
Turn up and stitch the open hems.
Add labels inside the back waistband and the hang tag.
